title: Adopted secure development standard aligned to SSDF
objective: Adopt and version a secure development standard that maps to NIST SSDF practices, assign owners and review it on material change.
residual_risks: The Standard is proposed, not adopted; no approval record exists.

title: Machine-checked security requirement traceability
objective: Link every security requirement and invariant to implementing changes, tests and evidence; fail validation when a control-relevant change has no mapped requirement or a requirement has no test.

title: Independent review of every change; two approvers for control-relevant modules
objective: Require review by someone other than the author for every change and two approvers, neither the author, for control-relevant modules; an AI agent cannot be the sole reviewer of an AI-authored change.
implementing_systems: Source control branch protection (not configured for a product)
residual_risks: With a very small team, two independent human approvers may not exist; the requirement cannot be met by headcount alone.

title: Security testing gates in the build
objective: Run static analysis including F#-specific rules, dependency and secret scanning, negative and property tests on every change; block merge on failures or on a tool failing to run.
implementing_systems: Praxis CI workflow (exists for tool repositories)
F# analyzers (ecosystem exists; rules not selected)
residual_risks: Mainstream SAST coverage of F# is limited; detection depends on structural rules and custom analyzers.

title: Role-based secure development competence for humans and agents
objective: Provide role-based secure development training to human developers at onboarding and annually, and maintain versioned, tested security instructions and tool restrictions for AI coding agents.
implementing_systems: Agent instruction files (AGENTS.md exists in repositories)

title: Bounded AI coding agent permissions and provenance
objective: Run coding agents with least-privilege repository and tool permissions, no production credentials, no ability to merge or release, and record actor, model, runtime and accountable human for every change.
residual_risks: Agent actor identity in Praxis is self-reported.
Prompt injection through repository content, issues or dependencies can steer an agent.

title: Memory-safe language policy enforced by build configuration
objective: Restrict shipped application code to approved memory-safe languages with F# as default, disallow unsafe code and unreviewed native interop through compiler settings and analyzers, and inventory exceptions.
implementing_systems: Directory.Build.props (TreatWarningsAsErrors set in Praxis and Strata)
residual_risks: The .NET runtime, WebAssembly runtime and native dependencies are not memory-safe by this policy.
Limen's kernel is TypeScript and a C# interop file exists.

title: Customer-facing secure development attestation
objective: Produce and sign a secure development attestation only when supporting evidence exists, with an explicit plan of action for unmet practices.
notes: 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: replaced rescinded SRC-OMB-M-22-18 with SRC-OMB-M-26-05 (informed-by); the attestation form is now optional for agencies.

title: Separated environments, no production data in development, no secrets in source
objective: Separate development, test and production accounts and credentials, prohibit production data in non-production without approved masking, and block secrets in source through scanning.
